scope: Culture festivals/concerts/film/art/markets plus currently owner-authorized real cafes/restaurants/bars/libraries/beautiful or hip spaces/scenic/architecture places. Preserve general legal/employment/immigration/visa/finance-information exclusions; current dated festival-daily-automation.md and event-prepublication-check.md govern facts/media/slots. Inventory is evidence only, not publication proof.
discovery: Resolve actual open cities each run; do not freeze the current five-city list.
Research each city's official/tourism calendar, then follow organizer, venue and authorized ticket links. Ticketmaster is one source, not the complete festival supply.
Follow date filters, pagination and Load more through the rolling research window; keep an uncapped candidate backlog, but stop repeated unchanged scans after coverage is recorded.
Prioritize cities below the two-new-bundle floor, then fill the shared 28-new-bundle target. Registered articles and previously used event editions do not replenish new Gling inventory.
A newly opened city lacking directory/timezone coverage needs source setup; hold that city's unknown data and continue other cities.
Maintain the existing city/official-URL/edition/event canonical key and factual revision history. An unchanged event is not a new post.
Resolve fact conflicts and legal photo supply independently; never fill a slot with invented or stale facts. Recheck current official notices before registration/publication.

Include actual place topics from the current Gling reference profile. Extract exact branch/address from observed non-Korean local recommendation sources; record source/view age/channel evidence, verified visiting value and decision/hash. Select through existing Jev/owner evidence; mix eligible places and events in the same four slots. Recheck actual place operation/conditions before native save and publication.

reference_analysis.activation_requires: Owner approval for paid API usage and a configured Typesafe account key; no paid requests or reservations/publications in this terminal.
reference_analysis.input: Textual observations from actual video/frame inspection, verified visible metrics, source/time/age/account context and verified event facts. Jev does not receive raw video or infer unseen audio.
reference_analysis.output: Typed format classification and brand-fit scoring only. Use the existing drafting workflow for copy; Jev is not a fact validator or free-form writer.
reference_analysis.reuse: Cache by source URL, media SHA-256, observation version and question/model version. Reuse reference classifications across events; do not classify the same video once per post.
reference_analysis.selection: Shortlist relevant official/local event references using visible metrics and actual media inspection. Views, confidence and cross-account comparisons do not prove conversion or an optimal format.
reference_analysis.application: Keep the approved six-file layout, fonts, tones, factual voice and licensing. Adapt original cover/photo choice, opening information order and permitted photo motion; do not download/repost benchmark video or add emoji/interview styling by default.
reference_analysis.fallback: If Jev is disabled, unavailable or uncertain, continue city research and use clearly labelled cached observed reference findings; never claim a Jev result was obtained.
reference_analysis.measurement: Link each future creative choice to its event/content ID and actual available views, saves, shares, profile clicks and Gling visits. Missing attribution is unknown; recommendations need our own measured feedback.

cost.pilot_assumption: 20 reference classifications at 5000 input tokens each = approximately USD 0.0042 for Jev only; no request has been sent.
cost.excluded: Collection, transcription/media understanding, generative writing, infrastructure and any paid safety checks are separate; total per-post cost has not been measured.

place_scope.topic_and_city_rotation: Compare recent exact branches/topics/cities and actual response; mix qualified candidates without cancelling reservations or inventing quota filler
place_scope.expiry: Events use verified edition dates; places use current exact-branch visitability and refreshed official facts, not fake event dates
